title: When Thoughts Become Memory: Unifying In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We are the first to give a certified rule for whether unseen data belong in a pretrained model's context or its weights, built on an exact law for their information value. That value, the code length saved on held-out queries, equals in expectation the bits stored about the query, plus a prior repair, minus a decoding loss, for any model, architecture, dataset and task. The law's ceilings certify the choice from one measurement, and an anytime-valid test makes it from held-out queries, with error controlled whenever it stops. Every certificate the ceilings issue on a trained transformer, TabPFN, an occupancy network and a stereo network is correct. The test picks TabPFN over XGBoost and a trained surrogate over an in-context learner on airfoil pressure, calls the better of GPT-2's cache and fine-tune in 61,948 of 64,000 query streams over 32 comparisons, and errs in at most 3.3% of null streams. translated_title: 当思想成为记忆：统一上下文学习与微调
translated_abstract: 我们首次给出了一个认证规则，用于判定未见数据应属于预训练模型的上下文还是其权重，该规则建立在其信息价值的精确定律之上。这一信息价值——即在留出查询上节省的编码长度——在期望上等于关于查询所存储的比特数，加上先验修复，再减去解码损失，且该定律对任何模型、架构、数据集和任务均成立。该定律的上界可通过一次测量来认证这一选择，而一个随时有效检验则可基于留出查询做出选择，且无论何时停止都能控制误差。在训练过的transformer、TabPFN、占用网络和立体匹配网络上，该上界颁发的每一份证书都是正确的。该检验在翼型压力预测任务上选择TabPFN优于XGBoost，选择训练后的代理模型优于上下文学习器；在32组比较、共64,000个查询流中，有61,948次正确判定GPT-2应使用缓存还是微调，且在零假设流中的错误率至多3.3%。该定律还能诊断何时学习（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文首次提出基于信息价值精确定律的认证规则，统一判定未见数据应放入预训练模型的上下文还是其权重，并通过随时有效的检验在多种模型与任务上验证了其正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to provide a certified rule, built on an exact information-value law, for deciding whether unseen data belong in a pretrained model's context or its weights, validated by an anytime-valid test across diverse models and tasks.
